name: io.github.idev9101-max/atlasdata-agent-tools
title: AtlasData Agent Tools
description: x402-paid news, weather, token verdicts, web search, PDF reading, security scans, work radar.

tools.name: scan_prompt_injection
tools.description: Classify agent-bound text for prompt-injection risk and return findings, score, and handling advice.

tools.name: redact_pii
tools.description: Detect and redact PII and secrets in text, including emails, phone numbers, cards, tokens, keys, and addresses.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web and return relevant URLs, titles, snippets, and reader links for agent research.

tools.name: read_web_page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page or PDF URL and extract clean readable text for agent retrieval.

tools.name: agent_work_radar
tools.description: Return live agent-work opportunities across contests, escrowed tasks, grants, and bounty networks with rewards, deadlines, blockers, and links.

tools.name: news_search
tools.description: Search live Google News for current events: exact headlines, publishers, publication times, source homepages, and article links for agent research.

tools.name: weather_report
tools.description: Get live global weather for any place or coordinates: current conditions, apparent temperature, precipitation, wind, pressure, next 24h hourly forecast, and 7-day outlook. Uses Open-Meteo and needs no upstream API key.

place.description: City or place name, for example London

tools.name: eth_block_number
tools.description: Latest Ethereum block height via eth_blockNumber.

tools.name: eth_chain_id
tools.description: Ethereum chain ID via eth_chainId.

tools.name: eth_erc20_balance
tools.description: ERC20 token balance for any Ethereum wallet via balanceOf, with token metadata.

tools.name: eth_live_balance
tools.description: Live Ethereum wallet ETH balance plus balances for up to 20 caller-supplied ERC20 tokens.

tools.name: eth_total_supply
tools.description: Total supply of an ERC20 or ERC721 token contract via totalSupply, with token metadata.

tools.name: eth_nonce
tools.description: Next transaction nonce for any Ethereum wallet via eth_getTransactionCount.

tools.name: eth_block
tools.description: Ethereum block header and transaction hashes by number, tag, or hex.

tools.name: eth_events
tools.description: Ethereum contract event logs via eth_getLogs, filtered by contract, topic, block range, and limit.

tools.name: eth_nft_owner
tools.description: Current owner of an ERC721 NFT by contract and token_id via ownerOf.

tools.name: eth_allowance
tools.description: ERC20 allowance for owner and spender via allowance(owner,spender), with token metadata.

tools.name: eth_contract_info
tools.description: Inspect an Ethereum contract: bytecode presence, ERC20 metadata, symbol, decimals, total supply, and contract classification.

tools.name: eth_nft_metadata
tools.description: Resolve ERC721 or ERC1155 NFT metadata on Ethereum, including tokenURI/uri, IPFS or Arweave metadata, image URL, name, and attributes.

tools.name: eth_erc721_tokens
tools.description: List ERC721 token IDs owned by a wallet in an enumerable Ethereum NFT collection using tokenOfOwnerByIndex.

tools.name: eth_erc20_transfers
tools.description: Read recent Ethereum ERC20 Transfer logs for a token, optionally filtered by wallet, with block range and decoded transfer fields.

tools.name: eth_resolve_ens
tools.description: Resolve an Ethereum ENS name to an address or reverse-resolve an address to its primary ENS name.

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Screen a token before trading: algorithmic grade, one-line verdict, roast, risk score, security flags, liquidity, volume, momentum, holder concentration, honeypot status, and live market metrics. Supports EVM contracts and Solana mints.
